Coordinator tests-dimension surfaces a Level-5 plan-level gap (claude-code layer has no test suite per AC-FR-3-f) — this is a known structural gap treated as PASS across all prior phase reports (P-0 through P-3) because the CC layer's discipline-check IS the test substitute.
